name: gr_set_card_disjoint_pairs
statement: (n : ℕ) : ((Finset.univ : Finset (Finset (Fin n) × Finset (Fin n))).filter (fun p => Disjoint p.1 p.2)).card = 3 ^ n
closed: ∀ (n : ℕ), ((Finset.univ : Finset (Finset (Fin n) × Finset (Fin n))).filter (fun p => Disjoint p.1 p.2)).card = 3 ^ n
informal: The number of ordered pairs of disjoint subsets of [n] is 3ⁿ — the bijection (A,B) ↦ (A,Bᶜ) maps disjoint pairs onto pairs with A ⊆ Bᶜ; Uses Mathlib2.comb_card_subset_pairs at the last step for the count of subset pairs.
